value.rationale: The physically natural distinction between time on a fixed-energy trajectory and uniform area in its interior produces different universal beta profiles and a strictly positive, parameter-independent amplification of rare-side visitation. Exact first anharmonic correction and sharp TV rate quantify robustness and provide inference of perturbation magnitude from observed shapes. This gives a motivated small-energy orbit-statistics classification beyond the known scalar period behavior; no paper-size or global classification claim made.
